description: A long mobile commit body hides its links until expanded. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Open Diffs: on a phone it is in the overflow menu: click the button named "More options", then, in its popover (".chat-overflow-popover"), the button whose accessible name starts with "Diffs" (".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label=\"Diffs\"]"). The ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. The ".diff-commit-message" has a visible "Show more" button and no ".diff-commit-message-links" element. Click "Show more". The body contains "FINAL BODY MARKER", "Show less" is visible, and ".diff-commit-message-links" has a link "Open on GitHub" with href "https://github.com/example/mobile-preview/commit/{{HASH}}" and a button "Open raw commit". Verify with eval expecting true that the body precedes the links in document order. Click "Show less"; the links are absent again. Click "Show more", then "Open raw commit". The button "View rendered" is visible and the rendered ".diff-commit-message" is absent. Click "View rendered"; the heading "Long mobile message" is visible again.
